problems: Complete absence of visual identity prevents trust establishment for a medical service

Inability to click-to-call or view hours on mobile devices leads to immediate user drop-off
mobile.quickFix: Implement a mobile-first responsive template that prioritizes a prominent 'Call Now' button and clear display of address and hours.

problems: No server response time as the site does not exist, resulting in infinite load time for any user attempt
Lack of any digital presence means no opportunity for Core Web Vitals optimization or caching
speed.quickFix: Deploy the website on a fast, managed hosting platform (e.g., Cloudflare Pages or Vercel) to ensure sub-1-second initial load times.

problems: Zero organic visibility for high-intent keywords like 'dentist in Chicago' or 'Big Smile Dental'
No structured data (LocalBusiness schema) to help search engines understand location, services, and ratings
seo.quickFix: Create a dedicated 'Dentist in Chicago' landing page with optimized title tags, meta descriptions, and embedded Google Maps location data.

problems: No call-to-action (CTA) mechanisms exist to convert visitors into patients
Absence of online booking or contact forms forces users to rely on third-party directories, losing direct lead capture
conversion.quickFix: Integrate a simple online appointment scheduler (e.g., Calendly or a dental-specific PMS plugin) with a sticky 'Book Appointment' button visible on all screens.
